The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu.
The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
cmu.licence: No restrictions stated by CMU (FAQ: may be copied, modified or redistributed); conversion adds none. Not a formal licence.
cmu.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (cgspeed BVH conversion, 2010 release)
cmu.note: Files are the unchanged BVH conversion (CMU skeleton, not the Second Life skeleton). Convert with tools/cmu_to_sl.py.

mesh2motion.credit: Animations from the Mesh2Motion project (CC0 1.0). No credit required; given as thanks.
mesh2motion.name: Mesh2Motion humanoid animations
mesh2motion.note: Only static/assets/human/animations/ is used. Never static/test-files/ (other origin, not CC0).

quaternius.credit: Animations from the Universal Animation Library by Quaternius (quaternius.com), CC0 1.0. No credit required; given as thanks.
quaternius.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library (standard, glTF copy)
quaternius.note: The free standard tier only, as copied unchanged from the author's itch.io download (2025-06-10) into a GitHub repository with glTF files only. One .gltf with 46 animations and its .bin. The paid Pro and Source tiers are never fetched. Convert with tools/convert_reference.py.
